summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Kitchen Display System (KDS) - Iteration 16. Backend: 23/23 tests passed. Frontend: All KDS features working correctly including board display, item status toggle, bump functionality, urgency colors, station filtering, column switcher, mute toggle, and settings page.
critical_code_review_comments: KDS endpoints properly require admin authentication (401 without auth)
GET /api/admin/kds/settings seeds defaults on first call and returns {audio_enabled, default_columns, target_prep_minutes_by_category, station_routing}
PUT /api/admin/kds/settings validates default_columns (must be 2/3/4) and returns 400 for invalid values
PUT /api/admin/kds/settings correctly persists audio_enabled, default_columns, prep times, and station routing
GET /api/admin/kds/board returns {orders, settings, server_time, count} with orders filtered to payment_status='paid' AND status in [preparing/ready/pending]
GET /api/admin/kds/board?station=X correctly filters items by station categories and preserves _line_index
PATCH /api/admin/kds/orders/{id}/items/{idx} validates status (pending/started/ready), returns 400 for invalid status/line_index, 404 for non-existent order
POST /api/admin/kds/orders/{id}/bump sets status='ready' for non-delivery, 'out_for_delivery' for delivery orders, records bumped_at
Frontend KDS board shows full-screen dark UI with station nav, column switcher, mute button, settings link, exit button
Order cards display order number, fulfillment badge, customer/table, elapsed timer (MM:SS), items with status buttons, bump button
Item status toggle cycles pending→started→ready with PATCH API call
Urgency colors work correctly: green (<80% of target), yellow (80-100%), red (>100% overdue with animate-pulse)
Station filtering correctly shows only orders with items matching station categories
Column switcher changes grid layout (2/3/4 columns)
Mute button toggles kds_muted in localStorage and icon switches Bell/BellOff
KDS settings page has all required elements: audio switch, default layout buttons, prep time rows, station cards with category chips
Admin sidebar has 'Kitchen (KDS)' link pointing to /admin/kds-settings
seed_data_creation: Created test orders via mongosh for KDS testing: orders with different urgency levels (green/yellow/red based on accepted_at timestamps), orders with different categories for station filtering (mains, drinks, salads). All test orders cleaned up after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 16 KDS fully tested. All backend endpoints working: GET/PUT /api/admin/kds/settings, GET /api/admin/kds/board, PATCH /api/admin/kds/orders/{id}/items/{idx}, POST /api/admin/kds/orders/{id}/bump. Frontend KDS board at /kds and /kds/:station working with all features: order cards, item status toggle, bump, urgency colors, station filtering, column switcher, mute toggle. KDS settings page at /admin/kds-settings working with audio switch, layout buttons, prep time management, station routing. Admin sidebar has Kitchen (KDS) link. Regression: Admin dashboard new-orders panel still working.

mocked_apis.note: Audio chime generated via Web Audio API (no external file). Real DB persistence for settings and item status.
